messages:
Rae: Heads-up — I opened PR 5410 to tidy the Console observability docs and found three issues in the preview: 1) the embedded dashboard gallery fell back to showing a code block (Netlify preview only); 2) a Ruby SDK snippet still uses `traceid` (no underscore) and `trace_id` appears in a few places; 3) the gallery image order is wrong because filenames got normalized to all lowercase and underscores.
Victor: Thanks. Can you paste the Netlify error? I couldn't reproduce locally with `mkdocs serve`.
Rae: Netlify logs: deploy 33801 -> AttributeRemoved: data-widget-id stripped by sanitizer. Preview URL: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/33801/logs. Locally the mkdocs build uses a different sanitizer setting which is why it's fine on dev.
Lina: I saw the same in PR 5388 last week. The sanitizer bump removed `data-*` attrs we rely on for widget hydration. Propose we add an allowlist for `data-widget-id` and `data-src` in the mkdocs config and revert the sanitizer change in the preview branch to unblock authors.
Rae: Agreed. Also the Ruby snippet looks like this now:```ruby
# old
client.send_trace(traceid: "abcd")
# should be
client.send_trace(trace_id_hex: "0xabcd")
```
Victor: Good catch. We standardized on `trace_id_hex` across SDKs to match runtime hex encoding. Please grep the repo: `git grep -n "\btraceid\b\|\btrace_id\b" docs || true` and list hits in the PR description.
Lina: I'll do the grep and push a small follow-up PR that updates Ruby, JS, and Java snippets. Also adding a short Migration note at the top of tracing.md with a before/after snippet and a link to the SDK changelogs.
doc-ci-bot: PR 5410 preview deploy failed: 422 MissingAttribute: `data-widget-id`. See logs: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/33801/logs
Victor: For the asset ordering bug, why were filenames normalized? That seems like a separate cleanup script.
Rae: The asset-normalize job ran as part of docs housekeeping and replaced spaces/hyphens with underscores and lowercased names. Netlify's gallery sorts by filename so order changed. We need to preserve hyphens for semantic ordering.
Lina: I'll re-upload the golden images under `docs/assets/console-gallery/` with hyphenated names and update the markdown to reference them explicitly.
Victor: We should also add a docs-lint GH Action that validates: (a) every image referenced in docs exists in the tree; (b) filenames do not contain underscores; (c) no `data-` attributes referenced unless whitelisted. I can open infra PR for that.
Rae: That would have caught both the missing image and the underscore rename. Please make the image-existence check non-blocking at first (warning) and then strict after a short rollout.
ops-bot: Note from ops: if the tracing examples change customers' instrumentation, we may see differing span IDs. @support please monitor for increased support tickets after docs update.
support: Acknowledged. We'll watch incoming issues and have a short reply template ready: "If you upgraded recently, check SDK versions and use trace_id_hex; see migration guide."
Victor: Plan: 1) revert sanitizer bump in PR 5410 to restore previews (Rae), 2) Lina pushes mkdocs allowlist and follow-up snippet fixes (Lina), 3) Victor opens infra/docs-lint action (Victor), 4) Rae re-uploads hyphenated golden images to `docs/assets/console-gallery/` (Rae).
Lina: I'll include this tiny migration snippet in tracing.md:```diff
- await client.trace({ trace_id: 'abcd' })
+ await client.trace({ trace_id_hex: '0xabcd' })
```
Rae: Creating tracking tasks: docs#5410/revert-sanitizer (Rae), infra#docs-lint (Victor), docs#5410/snippet-fixes (Lina), assets/upload-console-gallery (Rae). Ping here when infra PR is ready and I'll re-run the preview.
support: We'll draft the support blurb and share it in #support before the docs cutover.
Victor: No objections. I'll try to have the docs-lint action as a draft by EOD. Thanks team.
